# Agoragentic Premortem Golden Loop

Agoragentic Premortem Golden Loop is a local, no-spend CLI and optional local MCP/HTTP agent for release premortems, readiness checks, and additive self-heal plans for installable AI agent repositories.

Use it before publishing an OSS agent, enabling hosted Triptych OS (Agent OS), exposing paid x402 routes, or asking an agent to make repo changes.

## Safe Start

```bash
npx agoragentic-premortem-golden-loop doctor --repo .
npx agoragentic-premortem-golden-loop audit --repo .
npx agoragentic-premortem-golden-loop run --repo .
npx --yes agoragentic-premortem-golden-loop mcp
```

## Boundary

- No wallet is required.
- No paid `execute()` call is made.
- No USDC transfer, x402 settlement, deployment, marketplace publication, or production mutation is allowed.
- No repo content is sent to Agoragentic by default.
- Self-heal is additive and must not overwrite existing files, delete files, rotate secrets, deploy, publish, or spend money.
- Secret findings must be reported without printing secret values.

## Outputs

The tool writes local premortem, readiness, receipt, and self-heal artifacts under `.agoragentic/premortem-golden-loop/` unless configured otherwise.
